"use strict";

/**
 * UserPromptSubmit hook: verification discipline rule injection.
 *
 * Always emits a tight set of always-on verification rules.
 * When user prompt contains `++` or `@thorough`, also emits the thorough-mode
 * augment with execution discipline rules.
 *
 * Designed to complement (not replace) the thorough-mode plugin which handles
 * its own modifier injection. This hook is local — survives plugin updates.
 *
 * Source of truth for the rule content: ~/.claude/CLAUDE.md "Verification Discipline".
 * Keep CLAUDE.md and this hook in sync.
 */

const ALWAYS_ON = `[verification-rules] Apply to every task:
- Verify by reading code, not by checking that a file exists. Existence ≠ implementation.
- State the verifiable check that proves work done. "Done" is a vibe; "tests pass + parseX returns Y for input Z" is a check.
- Run the test suite after each substantive change, not at the end of a batch.
- On retrospective questions, enumerate gaps before strengths. Specifics, not vibes.`;

const THOROUGH_AUGMENT = `[verification-rules:thorough] Execution discipline:
- Small batches: one item at a time, verify between. Never merge multiple items into one "done" claim.
- End-to-end test new mechanisms before declaring wired. Function exports ≠ function runs.
- Update the plan / handoff / notes after each item, not at the end. Future sessions inherit only what's written.`;

const THOROUGH_TRIGGERS = []; // ++ / @thorough retired 2026-09-20 (thorough-mode 1.13.0): nothing arms the augment

// CANONICAL machine-text guard (same list as the mk-cc-resources hooks: thorough-mode,
// pattern-menu, kb-pull, turn-end). A prompt that OPENS with one of these is not the owner
// typing — it is a background-agent wake, a Stop-hook continuation, a slash-command record
// or a system reminder. Measured 2026-09-06: this hook fired 378 times across 212 human
// prompts and armed the thorough augment on an agent report that merely contained `++`.
const MACHINE_TEXT_MARKERS = [
  '[SYSTEM NOTIFICATION',
  '<task-notification>',
  'Stop hook feedback:',
  '<local-command',
  '<command-name>',
  '<system-reminder>',
  'Another Claude session sent a message',
];
const MACHINE_HEAD_CHARS = 200;

function isMachineText(prompt) {
  const head = String(prompt || '').replace(/^\s+/, '').slice(0, MACHINE_HEAD_CHARS);
  return MACHINE_TEXT_MARKERS.some((m) => head.startsWith(m));
}

function readPrompt() {
  return new Promise((resolve) => {
    let data = "";
    process.stdin.setEncoding("utf8");
    process.stdin.on("data", (chunk) => { data += chunk; });
    process.stdin.on("end", () => {
      if (data.trim()) {
        try {
          const parsed = JSON.parse(data);
          resolve(parsed.prompt || "");
          return;
        } catch (_e) { /* not JSON, treat as raw */ }
        resolve(data.trim());
        return;
      }
      resolve(process.env.CLAUDE_USER_PROMPT || "");
    });
    if (process.stdin.isTTY) {
      resolve(process.env.CLAUDE_USER_PROMPT || "");
    }
  });
}

async function main() {
  const prompt = await readPrompt();

  // Machine-authored prompts get nothing: the rules are already in the conversation from the
  // human prompt that opened the span, and re-injecting them on every wake is pure tax.
  if (isMachineText(prompt)) return;

  const out = [ALWAYS_ON];

  const thoroughActive = THOROUGH_TRIGGERS.some((rx) => rx.test(prompt));
  if (thoroughActive) {
    out.push(THOROUGH_AUGMENT);
  }

  process.stdout.write(out.join("\n\n"));
}

main().catch((err) => {
  process.stderr.write(`[verification-rules hook error] ${err.message}\n`);
  process.exit(0);
});
